shipped_rows.title_o: When the Wait Isn’t So Bad: The Interacting Effects of Website Delay, Familiarity, and Breadth

blind_target.evidence_quote: This study is an exact replication of an experiment investigating the impacts of website design on users’ ability to use a website and their opinion of the website (Galletta et al., 2006).
blind_target.outcome_quote: The replication confirms the importance of website design features, specifically delay, breadth, and familiarity on users’ ability to use and form an opinion of a website. However, the replication did not confirm the main finding, that it is the interplay of these three variables, i.e., cognitive cost, that predict performance and attitude.
blind_target.outcome_reasoning: Explicit agreement and disagreement with the target findings; main interaction finding unconfirmed, but the title does not focus specifically on that interaction.

luna_triage.reason: The abstract explicitly calls this an exact replication of Galletta et al. (2006). The sole supplied shipped original has Galletta et al. as authors, year 2006, and title describing the same website delay, familiarity, and breadth finding.
